text: You're looking for a high-protein vegan option that can be prepared within 45 minutes, and I think I have just the thing. This Scrambled Tofu recipe is a great fit for you, as it not only meets your protein requirements with 15 grams per serving but also incorporates your preference for tofu. The addition of nutritional yeast provides a cheesy, savory flavor without any animal products. With its quick preparation time and balanced nutrition, I'm confident you'll enjoy this dish and find it a great addition to your vegan meal repertoire.
